description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Set up a whole oriiion account for a customer and start their onboarding: it reads their website (or Instagram profile if they have no site), sets the brand, picks images, adds news sources and products, writes a style guide and drafts their first posts. Takes a few minutes and costs roughly $0.30 of generation per account. NOTHING is sent to the customer by this tool — check progress with get_customer_onboarding, then use send_customer_welcome once it looks right.

accountType.description: small_business for a company, thought_leader for a person building a personal brand

businessName.description: Business name, if known. The onboarding fills this in from the site otherwise.

email.description: The customer's email address — this becomes their login

instagramUrl.description: The customer's Instagram profile, used only when they have no website. A handle like @taximalmo is fine.

interfaceLanguage.description: Two-letter language for the customer's interface and emails. Defaults to sv.

websiteUrl.description: The customer's website. A bare domain like taximalmo.se is fine.
